title: Practice 4: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Общественные нормы ___ (варьировать) от страны к стране.
exercises.prompt: Social customs vary from country to country.
exercises.why: **варьировать → варьируют** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Old customs are gradually being destroyed.
exercises.why: **уничтожаться → уничтожаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: She's cleaning out her closet.
exercises.why: **убираться → убирается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I see her as a woman of faith.
exercises.why: **считать → считаю** — present-type form, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: I seem to have forgotten the pass.
exercises.why: **казаться → кажется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He spends money like water.
exercises.why: **разбрасываться → разбрасывается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I miss my parents.
exercises.why: **скучать → скучаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: What does the song of a nightingale sound like?
exercises.why: **звучать → звучит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Я ничего не ___ (смыслить) в ведении бизнеса.
exercises.prompt: I don't know a thing about running a business.
exercises.why: **смыслить → смыслю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: The Latin verb "laudare" is inflected according to the first conjugation.
exercises.why: **спрягаться → спрягается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: В том, что цены ___ (расти), правительство не виновато.
exercises.prompt: It isn't the government's fault that prices are rising.
exercises.why: **расти → растут** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: This music is making me sleepy.
exercises.why: **усыплять → усыпляет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Он ___ (выглядеть) таким счастливым, как будто он выиграл путёвку на Гавайи.
exercises.prompt: He looks as happy as if he had won a trip to Hawaii.
exercises.why: **выглядеть → выглядит** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Everyone reaps what they sow.
exercises.why: **пожинать → пожинает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: В праздничные дни время работы метро ___ (продлеваться) на час-полтора.
exercises.prompt: On holidays, the subway hours are extended by an hour and a half.
exercises.why: **продлеваться → продлевается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: How's the mum-to-be?
exercises.why: **поживать → поживает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: We have a long way to go.
exercises.why: **предстоять → предстоит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Женщина ___ (смотреть) на ламу в поле и улыбается.
exercises.prompt: The woman is looking at the llama in the field and smiling.
exercises.why: **смотреть → смотрит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Мой поезд ___ (прибывать) в Дюссельдорф завтра в шесть двадцать пять утра.
exercises.prompt: My train arrives in Düsseldorf at 6.25 a.m. tomorrow.
exercises.why: **прибывать → прибывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: We're listening to Celtic music.
exercises.why: **слушать → слушаем** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
